purpose: Test whether the real-SWAP history-preserving native service can publish a gradual positive infiltration onset, given that exact-origin isolated participants accept 1e-8 through 1e-6 cm/day but reject tested rates at and above 1e-5 cm/day.

fixed_conditions.geometry: Same 50-column, 1:1-mapped C1 MODFLOW6 6.8.0 strip, 1 m cells, left drain, no-flow right and bottom.
fixed_conditions.bootstrap: One accepted 0.001-day zero-forcing C2a equilibrium window from the exact C2E fixture origin.
fixed_conditions.forcing_semantics: Uniform prescribed top infiltration; positive values are inward rain magnitude. Each value applies for one complete 0.001-day service window; proceed only after the preceding window publishes.

gates.publish: Record each window outcome; a rejection terminates the ramp without advancing forcing or state.
gates.rollback: On rejection, profile hash, storage, participant revisions and ledgers must match the last accepted origin.
gates.mass: For every published window and cumulatively report rain input, SWAP-owned storage change, MODFLOW storage change if explicitly present in native budget, drain discharge, other external boundaries, and residual. Interface exchange remains internal.
gates.replay: Two independent fresh processes must produce byte-identical canonical result JSON.
gates.production: No production solver, temporal budget, coupling tolerance, mass gate, retry policy or ownership semantics changes.

interpretation_limit: This is a research-fixture service trajectory. Acceptance at any partial ramp does not establish a 0.1 cm/day envelope or production admission; a first-window rejection localizes the failure to the tested real-SWAP transaction onset before the MODFLOW state can advance.
